construction_language: Prose and concatenation/repetition recipes only. No generator or runner is supplied. Materialize in isolated temporary directories when implementation is authorized.

cli.require: For every positive case, stdout equals expected UTF-8 bytes, stderr is empty, exit is 0, and the input snapshot is unchanged.
For every positive case whose input differs, stdout is empty, stderr is exactly 'typed-preview fmt: formatting required\n', and exit is 1.
For every positive expected output, both streams are empty and exit is 0.
Same exact source output as default text diagnostics.
Exit 2, empty stdout, text CLI diagnostic on stderr, and no source open.
Exit 2, E0001/cli on stderr, empty stdout, no directory traversal or default source.
Exit 2 before either file is opened.
Exit 2 before opening input.
Exit 2 before opening input.
Exit 2; no write, no legacy fallback.
Format the regular file literally named --check; do not set check mode.
Exit 2 and do not read stdin.
Format a regular file literally named -; no stdin mode.
E0002/read, exit 2, empty stdout; folder children and manifest are not read.
E0002/read, exit 2, empty stdout; no fallback or candidate source.
Reject FIFO/device sources with E0002/read before reading source bytes; test with platform-appropriate facilities and do not claim metadata/open race immunity.
Symlink to a regular file succeeds when host permits; exact target bytes unchanged. Broken/directory-target symlinks fail read admission.
E0003/read, exit 2, empty stdout in format and check modes.

Use module_import_and_qualified_names with missing module files. Place unreadable/trap sibling sources, oxid.toml and cache markers nearby; only input is read, no discovery occurs, and no writes happen.

Use syntactically valid infinite recursion and while true source. Formatting terminates by syntax/format work, without interpreter/native/process invocation. A test harness should fail if any such seam is called.

Run from a read-only working directory with input readonly. Compare source and directory snapshots, excluding platform access-time effects. No .oxid, target, output or temporary source artifacts are created.

Inject bounded writer failures after zero bytes and after a short prefix, plus flush failure. Exit 2; never claim a complete atomic stream after partial write. Input unchanged; check mode never calls source stdout writer.

Default and explicit legacy fmt argv remain legacy routes. Use a disposable legacy fixture to preserve prior mutation behavior; typed errors must not reach that route. Preserve script payload edition/format words and -- separator handling.

Published check/run/compile option and diagnostic behavior is unchanged. Formatter JSON rejection is scoped to a successfully selected typed fmt route; preselection global routing errors keep existing behavior.
Reject as command/argument routing error; --check must follow fmt. No source read or legacy fallback.

resources.recipe: Let C(n) = '/*' + n ASCII x bytes + '*/'. Join 16 copies of C(65531) with one ASCII space and append LF.
resources.arithmetic: 16*65535 + 15 + 1 = 1048576 bytes; each comment is 65535 bytes; 32 non-EOF tokens.
resources.expect: Input at exact source cap is unchanged and accepted; check returns 0.

resources.recipe: Append one ASCII space to source_limit_exact_and_candidate_exact.
resources.expect: Input read rejects E0400 before lex/parse; max+1 bounded read; no stdout.

resources.recipe: Concatenate 16 copies of C(65531) without gaps.
resources.arithmetic: Input 1048560 bytes; output inserts 15 spaces and LF, reaching exactly 1048576.
resources.expect: Accept; second format identical and check on candidate returns 0.

resources.recipe: Concatenate one C(65532) and fifteen C(65531) without gaps.
resources.arithmetic: Input 1048561 bytes fits; each token fits; canonical output 1048577 bytes exceeds cap.
resources.expect: E0400/format before stdout in format and check modes.

resources.recipe: C(65532), one complete 65536-byte block-comment token.
resources.expect: Accept and append one LF, preserving exact comment.

resources.recipe: C(65533), one complete 65537-byte block-comment token.
resources.expect: E0400/lex before stdout.

resources.recipe: 65536 ASCII spaces.
resources.expect: Lex admission succeeds; output empty.

resources.recipe: 65537 ASCII spaces.
resources.expect: E0400/lex even though a successful formatter would otherwise discard boundary whitespace.

resources.recipe: Concatenate 50000 copies of '/**/' without gaps.
resources.arithmetic: 50000 input comment tokens become 50000 comment tokens + 49999 one-space tokens + one final LF token = 100000 output tokens.
resources.expect: Accept; output is comments joined by one space plus LF. Idempotence and check pass.

resources.recipe: Concatenate 50001 copies of '/**/' without gaps.
resources.arithmetic: 50001 input tokens fit; candidate would have 100002 non-EOF tokens.
resources.expect: E0400/format, empty stdout, no drift result from check.

resources.recipe: The expected output from output_token_exact: 50000 '/**/' comments separated by spaces, then LF.
resources.expect: Exactly 100000 non-EOF tokens; accept unchanged.

resources.recipe: Append '/**/' to input_token_exact.
resources.expect: Exactly 100001 non-EOF tokens: E0400/lex before formatting, despite a lexically complete input.

resources.recipe: Wrap true in 63 grouping pairs within 'fn f()->bool{return ...;}', then repeat with 64 pairs.
resources.expect: First fits 64 expression frames/height; second fails E0400/parse.

resources.recipe: Return a sum of 64 decimal 1 terms, then 65 terms, in a function.
resources.expect: 64 terms accepted, 65 fails E0400/parse; flat text must not evade AST-height bound.

resources.recipe: Function body plus 63 nested 'if true{' blocks, with return; innermost and matching closers; then use 64 nested if blocks.
resources.expect: 64 total active blocks accepted; 65 fails E0400/parse. No typechecking is needed.

resources.recipe: Function with 256 uniquely named i32 parameters / a direct call with 256 true arguments; then 257 each in separate sources.
resources.expect: 256 each admitted; 257 fails E0400/parse.

resources.recipe: A use path containing crate and 33 ordinary segments; then crate and 34.
resources.expect: 34 total admitted; 35 fails E0400/parse. No referenced modules exist or are read.

resources.recipe: At the production parse_counted seam use 'fn f()->(){true;return;}' with node_limit 4, then 3.
resources.arithmetic: Function 1 + true statement 1 + true expression 1 + return statement 1 = 4 nodes.
resources.expect: 4 succeeds, 3 fails E0400/parse. Also verify public configured limit stays 100000. Do not fabricate a natural 100001-node corpus that first violates another bound.

resources.recipe: More than 100 independently recoverable malformed top-level function declarations.
resources.expect: At most 100 diagnostics and empty source stdout; no suffix formatting.

resources.recipe: Use reduced injected limits at the same formatter admission code: a valid source whose independently counted delimiter/work-table requirement equals the limit, then lower that limit by one.
resources.expect: Exact boundary accepted, one-over rejected E0400/format before reserve/write. Production maxima remain stack 128 and logical scratch 8 MiB.

resources.recipe: Inject each formatter-owned fallible reserve failure, including output reserve, role table, comment anchors and candidate source owner.
resources.expect: E0400/format or existing source/parser resource diagnostic; no candidate stdout, no panic from the new formatter-owned failure path.

resources.recipe: Exercise checked count/add/multiply seams with synthetic length values that overflow usize without constructing huge source.
resources.expect: Reject before reserve or emission; no wraparound and no false small buffer admission.

invariants.require: Compare the single interleaved sequence of nontrivia (kind, raw bytes) atoms and (comment, raw bytes) atoms. Also compare comment token-neighbor ordinals and LF counts of interior gaps; apply RFC BOF/EOF normalization exceptions. Whitespace atoms and EOF are excluded from the protected sequence.

Parse input and expected/candidate independently in ProjectCandidate mode and compare all semantic fields/arena edges after location rebasing. Keep Group nodes, exact digit bytes/sign, visibility, item order and path segmentation.
For each positive case, format its expected bytes, require exact equality, then check with exit 0. Do not rewrite the golden from the actual result.
Deliberately alter one decimal digit, operator, grouping delimiter, trailing comma, comment byte or comment anchor in comparison inputs. Each comparator must reject its relevant mismatch.
Alter a normalized AST operator, literal sign, Group node, visibility, item order, path segment or borrow mutability while preserving unrelated fields. AST comparator must reject every mutation.

Generate legal whitespace-only perturbations of fixed independent goldens without splitting :: or changing line-comment reach; test fixed point and invariants. Do not assume different original LF patterns must converge to one output, because this slice preserves lines.
Goldens remain hand-authored. Resource counts come from formulas above. AST normalization and projection comparators must not call the formatter or reuse its token-role/spacing decision helpers.
